rules.statement: A court may add a party to an action at any time before judgment is pronounced, provided the addition would enable it to effectively adjudicate all questions involved.
rules.supporting_quote: "The language of section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code that the Court 'may at any time order that the name of any person whose presence before the Court may be necessary in order to enable the Court effectually and completely to adjudicate upon and settle all the questions involved in the action' is wide enough to cover this case and to allow the addition of a fresh party at any time before the decision of the action, that is, before the judgment is pronounced."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 18 of the Civil Procedure Code
